name: spellkave_session_status
label: Spellkave Session Status
description: Summarize the connected actor's in-world turn/scene (not the MCP connection): lifecycle, roster order, and whose turn it is. Accepts no session or actor id. `no_session` still allows exploration. The orientation tool also includes this in-world session state.

limit.description: Ongoing sessions per page; implies detail.

cursor.description: Continuation from ongoing.next_cursor; implies detail. Restart without cursor if the list changes.

detail.description: Include authorized operation details and world-tick timing, including initiated and external-wait phases.

session_id.description: Read details for a previously observed session, including its terminal state. Requires participation; implies detail.
